name: Job type: Transcribe call recordings
value: 24/day, critical, deadline 3 h: 1x 60 min @ 1.0 GPU (not interruptible)
source: Inference job (Whisper-type speech model; Whisper is an MLPerf Inference v6.1 benchmark). One full GPU like 45.5 % of trace tasks; 60 min is above the trace median for inference GPUs (T4: 5.7 min, p90 119 min) because a batch of recordings is bundled. Deadline and volume: ASSUMPTION.

name: Job type: Retrain recommendation (CTR) model
source: 'ctr' is the 2nd most common workload tag (26 % of tagged instances). 120 min sits between the trace p75 (63 min) and p90 (212 min). Deadline (ready next morning) and volume: ASSUMPTION.

name: Job type: Embed document archive (BERT)
value: 20/day, flexible, deadline 24 h: 4x 30 min @ 0.5 GPU; 1x 15 min @ 0.5 GPU
source: 'bert' is the most common workload tag (53 % of tagged instances). Half a GPU like 15.8 % of trace tasks (26-50 % GPU request). 30 min batches ~ trace p50-p75. Merge waits for all batches. Volume: ASSUMPTION.

name: Job type: Fine-tune language model (NMT/BERT)
value: 3/day, flexible, deadline 72 h: 4x 480 min @ 1.0 GPU; 1x 30 min @ 1.0 GPU
source: Long training tasks carry most GPU time in the trace: tasks of 8 h or more hold 61 % of GPU-hours. 4 workers + an evaluator follows the trace's worker/evaluator roles. Checkpointed, so interruptible. Deadline and volume: ASSUMPTION.

name: Job type: Hyper-parameter sweep
source: Short tasks on a GPU share: 36.2 % of trace tasks request 25 % of a GPU or less; trace median duration 10 min (rounded up to one 15-min slot). Volume: ASSUMPTION.

name: Job type: Image recognition (measured on our laptop)
source: MEASURED on our laptop (LAPTOP-3KIFGH78, 2026-11-22T01:44:52): 2,719,744 images in 120 s (22,664/s), laptop 29.3 W under load (battery discharge meter), 0.98 Wh. Scaling (ASSUMPTION): same energy per image on the 1 kW server -> 2,785,997,951 images per server-hour; one job = 30 min of a 1 kW server = 1,392,998,975 images. Interruptible: the process is suspended/resumed and keeps its progress. Deadline 24 h and 16 jobs/day: ASSUMPTION.
